hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Plunger lubricator and catcher
function: The housing on the tree cap that receives the plunger, with a spring or catcher, an arrival sensor, and a cap for changing the plunger.

tabs.overview: The plunger stops here on each arrival; the catcher holds it for inspection; the sensor tells the controller it arrived.
tabs.safety: Bled through the cap valve before opening.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
